morphology.compounding_rule: Latin [adjective|resource](stem) + feature-word, eliding before a vowel (ater + sonia -> Atrasonia, black-plain) layered over Plains descriptive [quality|animal] + feature compounds bent to Latin shape (Ecatoyus, red-mountain; Cutsusonia, bison-plain): the capital Nova Roma, the colony Colonia Toyana (the mountain-colony).
morphology.patronymic_form: the Latin ruling stock carry an inherited gens (clan) name as the middle element (Marcus Toyanius); the Plains substrate keep the band/division name (e.g. Cuahada, Penateca, Latinized) and an earned deed- or vision-name; the throne fuses both - a praenomen + gens who also carries a band-name and a vision-byname.

patterns.dungeons_ruins: buried legion-colonies and old burial-scaffolds: 'the Catacombs of Divus [name]', 'the Sunken Colonia', 'the Medicine-Cairn of [chief]', 'the Ghost-Butte of [name]'
patterns.military_units: Legio [ordinal] [cognomen] fused with the warrior-societies: 'Legio Prima Equestris (the Horse Legion)', 'the Eagle Standard', 'the Dog-Soldiers (Hotametaneo)', 'the Kit-Fox society'
patterns.ships: river-galleys and the prairie riders' war-lances and great horses: 'Aquila' (the Eagle), 'Dawn of Nova Roma', 'the Red Lance', 'Cloud-Eater' (a famed war-horse)
patterns.taverns: The [Adjective] [Noun] of the forum-town, and the council-lodge of the camp: 'The Iron Eagle', 'The Gilded Lance', 'the Great Council-Lodge'

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon - Latinate canon-morphs PRIMARY (the agrippan keys, the reference culture other cultures rename FROM), Plains morphs SECONDARY (family_north_american.json theonym_sets.plains / numinan), never real Roman/Plains gods. Shared pantheon, two registers (Latin primary, Plains secondary). Novarom allows Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic; its stance follows its CURRENT alignment (see worship_by_alignment). The powers are met both at the built temple-on-the-forum and at the medicine-bluff of the open sky - the law-stone and the vision-quest (puha) honored alike.

clergy_ladder.7: Pontifex (High Priest) / Numunu-puhacatus (the band's high seer)
clergy_ladder.9: Pontifex Maximus / Naica-puhacatus (the council's great seer)

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the Chaotic powers, warded as daemones (Latin) or the dread sky-/storm-spirits (Plains), keep their morphs + an epithet: Maraxus -> Maraxus the Tyrant-Flame (Plains Maraksa the War-Fire); Dementus -> Dementus the Storm-Mad (Plains Tamawi the Thunder); Lusanto -> Lusanto the Coin-Serpent (Plains Lusanta the Greed-Worm).

holy_symbol_motifs.Gaiandus: the plowed field and the grass-sea beneath the open sky
holy_symbol_motifs.Orlandus: the legion-eagle crossed with a war-lance over an iron oath-ring
holy_symbol_motifs.Tulrius: a rayed sun-disc above a balance and a law-stone

religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Collegium of [power] at the forum-temple (Collegium of the Dawn Throne, Tulrius), or the medicine-bluff / vision-cairn of [power] on a high place (the Medicine-Bluff of Maraksa).
religion.saints_pattern: Divus/Diva [name] - the deified founders and legion-heroes inscribed on the law-stone, and the great chiefs and vision-seers who became sky- and animal-spirits, honored at the catacomb, the forum-stele, the burial-scaffold and the medicine-cairn.

sample_deity_renames.Gaiandus: Gaiandus (Plains Kayanta) - the enduring earth, the field and the grass-sea
sample_deity_renames.Numeno: Numeno (Plains Nimawi) - air, sky-wisdom, the scribe and the seer
sample_deity_renames.Orlandus: Orlandus (Plains Olanta) - iron, oath, war; the legion-eagle and the war-lance
sample_deity_renames.Realta: Realta (Plains Reawina) - the mother, mercy, the life-giving rain
sample_deity_renames.Tulrius: Tulrius (Plains Torawi) - the sun and justice, the law-stone and the open sky

religion.the_one: Aeternus (Plains Ateruna) - the One / True God; honored in liturgy and acknowledged as the distant Great-Above, not petitioned

worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: venerates the Chaotic powers of the canon (Maraxus the war-fire, Dementus the storm, Lusanto the greed-serpent) and names the Lawful powers - and Aeternus - as the tyrant-gods to be defied (the cold sky-tyrant, the chain)
worship_by_alignment.Lawful: venerates the Lawful powers - Aeternus, Tulrius the just, Orlandus of the sworn legion, Realta the merciful - at the forum-temple and the medicine-bluff alike, and names the Chaotic powers daemones (Latin) or the dread-spirits (Plains), warded; the law-stone and the vision-quest bind together
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: the ancestral dead (the deified founders and the great chiefs), the city-spirits of the urbs and the animal-spirits and the medicine (puha) of place; the great powers invoked at the forum-altar and the medicine-cairn situationally

titles._tiers_note: Latinate ladder, ascending (the Agrippan civic ladder), with the Plains substrate co-titles beneath. Castellanus/Castellania barony; Limitanus/Limitania (the frontier limes) march; Comes/Comitatus county; Dux/Ducatus duchy; Princeps/Principatus principality; Rex/Regnum kingdom; Imperator over the Imperium (empire). The riding bands keep their Plains chiefs within the realm: the paraibo (band peace-chief) and the tecuniwap (war chief) lead the akicita warrior-societies beneath the Latin crown; the medicine-seer (puhacatus) and the civic scribe stand outside the ladder. The empire ruler-title 'Imperator' is the approved commonly-known foreign term, shown in DISPLAY (not Englished to 'Emperor'); all other tiers display English. Rank titles fuse the real Latin and Plains registers (allowed). Per-tier family/realm size thresholds come from the ACKS domain rules (acore_axioms_strongholds_and_domains.xml); not reproduced here for IP.
titles.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH, except where an approved commonly-known foreign term is set in 'ruler' (the empire tier shows 'Imperator'). The *_native conlang forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.
titles.government: feudal (a Latinate legionary aristocracy fused with the Plains horse-nomad bands: the Imperator and his princeps-kin at the crown, the comes-governors over the urbs-cities, the castellanus-lords sworn to the legion and the war-society; the paraibo-headmen and the akicita warrior-societies of the riding bands serve within the realm, the medicine-seers and the civic scribes beneath)
titles.heir: Caesar (heir-designate to the Imperator; the king's child)
